newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Volume fell to 1.9 billion yuan from 2.9 billion yuan on Tuesday, with the 60-day contract the most active.
Traders said some rates lost today mainly due to lending from securities houses and brokerages who need less money due to the recent downward trends on the stock markets.
State banks also joined in the lending with short-term money supply ample at the national level, they said.
"With the year-end approaching, most financial instititions are not willing to build positions," said one trader. "This has pushed the rates slowly down on thin volume."
Traders expect the rates to move in a narrow range in dull trading in the short term.
